title: Replace Yandex with two selected-provider weather adapters and isolated state

gates.name: Host Weather Context and redacted adapter probes

verify: Establish claim-linked RED from current production state: Yandex is the only production adapter, Weather Context has no selected-provider dispatch, and cache/history records do not carry provider plus location identity. Do not treat fixture compatibility or terminal W15 Yandex evidence as target behavior.

With fake HTTPS transports, prove exactly two production WeatherProvider adapters: Open-Meteo default/no-key and OpenWeather explicit/local-key. A refresh invokes exactly one selected adapter, never the other, and production wiring contains no Yandex provider path or third adapter.

For Open-Meteo, observe the canonical coordinate/timezone/current/hourly/daily request shape with no credential field. For OpenWeather, observe the One Call 3.0 request shape and only a boolean/redacted receipt that `appid` was present in the ephemeral outbound HTTPS request; no key value may survive in DTOs, errors, logs, fixtures or evidence.

Decode deterministic redacted fixtures for each provider into one provider-neutral Weather Context envelope, preserve selected-city timezone and provider capability metadata, map current/four-card optional fields honestly, and use neutral cloud/regular moon fallback without invented labels or crashes.

Exercise launch, city change, explicit provider change and 30-minute refresh. Cache lookup/visibility and seven-day history/trends must key by provider plus location; only a fresh matching cache may remain visible, and provider/location changes cannot reuse or compare a different partition.

Exercise HTTP/auth/malformed/timeout/missing-required-data failures for each selected provider. The result must be atomic, preserve selection, avoid a second-provider request or substitution, retain only matching fresh cache, and leave clock/timer paths independent.

Use synthetic credentials, fake transports, deterministic time/location and disposable stores. No live endpoint, emulator/device evidence or runtime PASS claim is permitted; host/build/static/redaction evidence is mandatory.
Closure later requires fresh /verify PASS and /red-verify semantic-pass for all task-owned Revision-2 claims; scheduler promotion remains external.

purpose: Replace the historical Yandex production path with the accepted provider-neutral Weather Context, exactly two adapters and provider/location-isolated state without introducing a provider framework.
success_outcome: A clean build and deterministic redacted evidence prove that Weather Context dispatches only the selected Open-Meteo or OpenWeather adapter, normalizes both into one ownership model, partitions cache/history by provider and location, never falls back or mixes data, and keeps OpenWeather appid ephemeral and redacted.
anti_goals: Do not keep Yandex as a production provider or add any third provider.
Do not implement a plugin framework, adapter registry, DI framework, service locator, event bus or parallel provider race; one explicit selection branch is sufficient.
Do not own FT-003 exact eight-slot entry or FT-004 Open-Meteo-10/OpenWeather-8+2 projection; this task only preserves raw normalized provider data and capability metadata for those dependents.
Do not move provider selection/key ownership out of Settings & Location or add backend/shared-key/cloud behavior.
Do not use live endpoints or retain OpenWeather appid outside the ephemeral outbound HTTPS request.

forbidden_scope: third provider, cross-provider fallback, data substitution, mixed cache/history or parallel provider requests
plugin/DI registry, service locator, event/message infrastructure and speculative provider extensibility
FT-003 hourly session presentation/exit and FT-004 long-term layout/8+2 capability projection
Settings catalog/personalization implementation, Timer & Alert behavior and unrelated Main Display layout
live credentials, live provider calls and secret-bearing source/logs/fixtures/evidence
stop_conditions: Stop and ask the operator before changing the exact two-provider set, default provider, no-fallback rule, cache/history identity or secret posture.
Stop and route to /spec-design if implementation requires a new module, graph edge, public boundary, storage owner or composition-root business orchestration.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-002 if task identity, tier, dependency, AC ownership or material scope must change.
Stop and leave strict hourly completeness to TASK-021-T2-FT-003-W18 and long-term capability projection to TASK-022-T2-FT-004-W19.

constraints: Weather Context owns provider-neutral normalization, refresh, selected-provider dispatch, cache/history and public weather projections; adapters own only provider transport decoding.

There are exactly two selectable production adapters: Open-Meteo default/no-key and OpenWeather explicit/local-key. One refresh calls exactly one selected adapter with no automatic fallback or mixing.
Cache and history identity is provider plus selected location; freshness and trend comparisons never cross either identity component.
OpenWeather appid exists only in the ephemeral outbound HTTPS request and is redacted everywhere else; Open-Meteo receives no credential.
The implementation remains the existing modular monolith with one interface, two adapters, Settings state, cache/history and composition wiring; no provider framework is authorized.
No hard write_boundary is declared because Yandex replacement may require adjacent project-conventional files; advisory files plus forbidden scope and stop conditions remain binding.
